summary.intent: Review and update the codebase map, identify E2E testing gaps and capture them as todos, analyze technical concerns and add remediation phases to the roadmap, then kick off Phase 28 (Code Hygiene & Logging) discussion via the GSD manager.
summary.outcome: 6 new todos captured for E2E testing improvements and staging baselines; 5 new phases (28-32) added to the v1.1 roadmap covering code hygiene, infra hardening, observability, structural decomposition, and FUSE async resolution; Phase 28 CONTEXT.md written with locked decisions; two PRs merged (#380, #381); markdownlint exclusion fixed for .planning/ files.

repo: Only 1 of 12 E2E specs (recovery.spec.ts) calls deleteTestAccount() — all others leave orphaned test accounts after test runs
deleteTestAccount() helper already exists in tests/sdk-e2e/src/fixtures/test-harness.ts using DELETE /auth/account with { confirmation: 'DELETE' }
AES-CTR streaming is fully implemented with 35 unit tests but zero E2E tests; Phase 12.1 left a human verification checklist never automated
CTR mode is selected for media files >256KB, GCM for everything else in streaming-crypto.service.ts
Service Worker intercepts /decrypt-stream/* URLs and handles HTTP Range requests for seeking in decrypt-sw.ts
139 console.* calls across 29 files in apps/web/src/ — largest offender is hooks.ts with 34 calls leaking Web3Auth SDK state
11 .catch(() => {}) silencing unpin failures in bin.service.ts, useFileOperations.ts, useFileVersions.ts, ReplaceFileDialog.tsx, useDropUpload.ts
00-Preliminary-R&D/poc/ contains 89MB of committed node_modules and deprecated ipfs-http-client@60.0.1 — fully superseded
Web3AuthMPCCoreKit type IS exported from core-kit.ts, making the coreKit: any cast in hooks.ts fixable
Pino browser mode lacks redaction support and Sentry integration — both are Node.js only, making a custom logger wrapper the right choice for this privacy-focused app
lint-staged runs markdownlint --fix on all *.md files via package.json glob, which overrides .markdownlintignore for files passed explicitly
.planning/phases/ and .planning/milestones/ were already in .markdownlintignore but top-level .planning/ files were not

code.finding: deleteTestAccount() helper exists but is only wired up in recovery.spec.ts; needs to be added to all 12 specs' afterAll hooks

Service Worker handles /decrypt-stream/* URL interception and HTTP Range requests for seeking
34 console.* calls (largest file), coreKit: any and loginParams: any casts — both fixable

workflow: GSD manager dashboard correctly shows Blocked status for phases with unmet dependencies (30 and 31 blocked on 28)
GSD todo count in STATE.md can go stale — always verify actual file count before arithmetic updates
Pino browser mode research saved before committing to logger design — pino redaction and Sentry integrations are Node.js only, not browser-compatible
lint-staged --ignore flag does not reliably exclude files when paths are passed explicitly; glob-level exclusion in package.json lint-staged config is required
Avoiding markdown special characters (like *) entirely in planning docs is more robust than fighting the linter config

friction: STATE.md todo count was stale (showed 10 when it was already 10 before the session), causing a wrong 10+4=14 display — caught by user

markdownlint via lint-staged kept re-escaping asterisks in ROADMAP.md on every commit despite adding .planning/ to .markdownlintignore — required 4+ fix commits before root cause (lint-staged glob bypasses ignore file) was found and resolved
GSD manager init returned broken JSON due to escaped asterisk in ROADMAP.md, requiring the ROADMAP fix before dashboard could render
Manager init bash command needed multiple retry attempts to successfully parse state after the ROADMAP escaping issue
